title: Multiplication program correctness
statement: For every finite bit string $x$, the specified 13-register oracle program, started in its length-testing state with all registers zero and no answer recorded, halts with answer true exactly when $x$ encodes a pair of binary numerals whose product is the third numeral. Throughout every step before halting, its configuration satisfies the program’s safety conditions and every register is at most $4(|x|+1)$.
caveat: The safety predicate includes instruction-specific validity conditions from definitions whose informal descriptions were not supplied; the statement summarizes that predicate as the program’s safety conditions.
